company.name: MetaDoc
company.shortDescription: MetaDoc offers primary health care services to people without the need to leave their premises.
company.description:
MetaDoc offers a comprehensive yet outreach primary healthcare medical service platform that utilizes the latest state-of-the-art and bespoke healthcare technologies in providing a patient-centric, world-class, and evidence-based medical practice. The service is provided by “Medihealth Solutions Pty Ltd”, Australia, which is a leading and emerging fast-paced and forward-thinking company.

MetaDoc offers the convenience of seeing a highly qualified, experienced, and accredited doctor without the need to leave your premises. Their doctors are on the road and ready to attend to patients’ premises; providing the best care, after conducting a systematic thorough examination, and complying with international standards; that is a subject of constant auditing and supervision by our Chief Medical Officer.

Our Doctors are equipped with all the needed state-of-the-art equipment that guarantees, conducting a comprehensive medical examination. The doctor will be able to provide the patients with the first doses of any prescribed medications. In addition to that, our electronic prescription system will allow you to have your prescribed medications, delivered to your doorstep with clear instructions for administering the correct dosage. Moreover, if the doctors feel that your condition renders you unfit to work or attend the university or school, they will issue your medical certificate and email it after the visit.

Shall there be any further investigations required like blood tests etc., our electronic investigation requesting system will organize a booking for the requested test and the laboratory staff will soon get in touch to organize a suitable time, for attending to the patient’s premises and collecting the specimens? Being committed to providing the continuity of medical care, our doctors will check the results and discuss with you the finding during a follow-up phone call, video conference, or a second visit if required.

MetaDoc is not an emergency service; hence, our triage nurses will only take the bookings for the patients that suffer from acute but not emergent medical conditions complying with the company’s policy and divert any emergency to the emergency services, if appropriate. However, our doctor might refer the patient to a hospital, if the doctor suspects any potential risk or confirms any acute emergency that would be deemed unsuitable for home care. Our Doctor will then work with the control tower on organizing the patients’ transfer to the nearest hospital if required.

Download our “MetaDoc” mobile phone app. It makes scheduling or requesting a doctor’s home visit, simple, quick, and easy; you can click to call for immediate assistance or submit an online request. It is your ideal tool, making your access to the itinerary, appointment reminders, and your personal medical records, literally in your hand, at all times!

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,900,000, or 30.16% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,621,496 to $15,788,999, a 2.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
